fieldNotes.truckGate: Sliding wrought-iron gate across the entrance driveway off W Nance St at the SW corner; red signage on the gate panel. Confirmed in Street View (pano 2026-02) and z21 satellite of the throat.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth beside the entrance lane in satellite (z20/z21) or Street View - the gated throat has only landscaped islands, no 1-3-stall structure.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but no guard booth, so check-in is kiosk/call-box/app (remote).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building: dock aprons with trailers on BOTH the north and south long faces (published as cross-dock); shipping and receiving run from physically separate dock banks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Published 112 dock-high doors (REBusinessOnline/Newmark); visually consistent - long rows of trailers backed in along both N and S faces. Band 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Published 224 trailer-parking spaces; large striped truck yard north of the north dock apron plus south yard. Band 50+.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~70 trailers visible across N apron, S apron and yards in the captured imagery (estimate).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron and deep driveway with unused paved width inside the gate - room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep gate-to-yard/dock approach holds 3+ trucks; large post-gate apron.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: W Nance St is a wide divided road with turn lanes and the gate is set well back - a queue would not spill onto the road.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Perris IE logistics corridor; ranch/residential lots with open land directly across Nance St. Judged Rural per rubric tiebreak.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Fenced operational yard ~35.8 acres from the perimeter polygon; full assessor parcel published as ~43 acres incl. the vacant expansion lot to the west (excluded from the active geofence).
